timeline.summary: On April 30, 2026, Ethos acquired a 2.37% stake in subsidiary Ethos Lifestyle Private Limited from promoter Pranav Shankar Saboo for ₹20.26 Cr, raising its holding to 77.42%.
Opened a new 8,070 sq. ft. watch boutique in Jaipur on 30 April 2026, reaching 97 stores across India.
Ethos opened a new watch boutique at Phoenix Market City in Pune on 1 May 2026, bringing its store count to 98 across India.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹414.01 Cr (+33.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹22 Cr.
Ethos reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,612.2 Cr, up 28.8% YoY, while expanding its store network to 98 boutiques.
Ethos' March-2026 monitoring agency report showed ₹109.79 Cr of its ₹409.91 Cr rights issue proceeds used and ₹300.12 Cr unutilised, with Crisil flagging a delay tied to postponed store openings.
Ethos opened a new watch boutique in Indore, bringing its total national store count to 100.
Ethos Limited opened its 100th watch boutique in Indore, expanding its national network across 32 cities.
Ethos opened a watch boutique at Terminal 2, IGI Airport, Delhi, taking its network to 101 boutiques across India.
CGST Appellate Authority dismissed Ethos' appeal, upholding penalties of ₹2.16 Cr; company plans further appeal.

Ethos Limited received an order from GST Appellate Authority Noida dismissing its appeal for FY 2018-19 and FY 2019-20, upholding tax demand ₹13.26 lakh and penalty ₹13.26 lakh, effective October 15, 2026.
